Now if we multiply division of circular scale with least count then we get 0th digit of fraction part even.

$$ \Rightarrow $$ $${1 \over {4{R_e}}}$$ = $$ - {1 \over R} + {{3{R_e}} \over {4{R^2}}}$$

$$ \Rightarrow $$ $${\alpha ^2} - 6\alpha + 9 = {\alpha ^2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow \alpha = {3 \over 2}$$

$$ \therefore $$ $$r = {3 \over 2}$$

$$ \Rightarrow $$ 2r = 3 = diameter.
